# Grit

> Grit is a fast Git implementation in Rust: grit-lib is a linkable library for Rust programs, and grit is a modern Git client built on that library. On-disk formats and the wire protocol stay compatible with Git.

Each docs page has a Markdown twin at the same URL with `index.md` instead of `index.html`. Use `grit --json` (and `--markdown` on many commands) for script- and agent-friendly CLI output.

## Getting started

- [Docs](https://grit-scm.com/docs/index.md): How to use grit, a simple Git client built on grit-lib. Start with the tutorial, then look up any command or open the library guide.
- [Install grit](https://grit-scm.com/docs/install/index.md): Install the grit CLI on your machine, try nightly builds, and keep your copy up to date.
- [Tutorial](https://grit-scm.com/docs/tutorial/index.md): Fifteen minutes with grit. Create a repository, record some changes, work on a branch, and share it with a remote.
- [Library quick start](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library-quickstart/index.md): Add grit-lib to a Rust project, open a repository, and read the current commit from HEAD.

## The grit CLI

- [Global options](https://grit-scm.com/docs/global-options/index.md): Options that apply to every grit command.
- [Scripting with grit](https://grit-scm.com/docs/scripting/index.md): Use --json and --filter to build scripts on top of grit.
- [Agent guide](https://grit-scm.com/docs/agents/index.md): Run grit from scripts and autonomous agents — JSON output, exit codes, non-interactive use, credentials, and where to read the docs.
### Getting started

- [grit init](https://grit-scm.com/docs/init/index.md): Create a new, empty repository.
- [grit clone](https://grit-scm.com/docs/clone/index.md): Copy a remote repository into a new directory.
- [grit status](https://grit-scm.com/docs/status/index.md): Show where you are and what's changed. This is what plain grit runs.
- [grit config](https://grit-scm.com/docs/config/index.md): Read, set, list or remove configuration values.
### Making changes

- [grit add](https://grit-scm.com/docs/add/index.md): Stage changes. With no paths, stages everything.
- [grit commit](https://grit-scm.com/docs/commit/index.md): Stage every change and record a new commit.
- [grit diff](https://grit-scm.com/docs/diff/index.md): Show uncommitted changes, or the change a commit introduced.
### History

- [grit log](https://grit-scm.com/docs/log/index.md): Show recent commits, newest first, a page at a time.
- [grit shortlog](https://grit-scm.com/docs/shortlog/index.md): List the commits on this branch that aren't on the target branch yet.
- [grit show](https://grit-scm.com/docs/show/index.md): Show a commit, tag or branch, and a summary of what it changed.
### Branches and tags

- [grit branch](https://grit-scm.com/docs/branch/index.md): List branches, or create or delete one.
- [grit switch](https://grit-scm.com/docs/switch/index.md): Switch to another branch, or create one and switch to it.
- [grit merge](https://grit-scm.com/docs/merge/index.md): Merge another branch into the current one.
- [grit pick](https://grit-scm.com/docs/pick/index.md): Copy a single commit onto the current branch.
- [grit tag](https://grit-scm.com/docs/tag/index.md): List tags, or create or delete one. A new tag points at the current commit.
### Remotes

- [grit remote](https://grit-scm.com/docs/remote/index.md): List remotes, add one, or list refs on a remote.
- [grit fetch](https://grit-scm.com/docs/fetch/index.md): Download new commits, branches and tags from a remote.
- [grit pull](https://grit-scm.com/docs/pull/index.md): Fetch from the remote and bring the current branch up to date.
- [grit push](https://grit-scm.com/docs/push/index.md): Publish the current branch, or your tags, to a remote.
- [grit auth](https://grit-scm.com/docs/auth/index.md): Sign in to GitHub so HTTPS pushes and fetches just work.
- [grit bundle](https://grit-scm.com/docs/bundle/index.md): Create, verify, and list git bundle files for offline transfer.
### Maintenance

- [grit update](https://grit-scm.com/docs/update/index.md): Update grit to the latest release.
- [grit skill](https://grit-scm.com/docs/skill/index.md): Print an agent skill that explains how to use grit.
- [grit completions](https://grit-scm.com/docs/completions/index.md): Generate shell completion scripts for bash, zsh, and fish.
### Plumbing

- [grit upload-pack](https://grit-scm.com/docs/upload-pack/index.md): Serve a fetch or clone of a repository over stdin and stdout.
- [grit receive-pack](https://grit-scm.com/docs/receive-pack/index.md): Accept a push to a repository over stdin and stdout.
- [grit manager](https://grit-scm.com/docs/manager/index.md): A credential helper that stores passwords and tokens in the Windows Credential Manager.

## Library guide

- [Overview](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/index.md): Use grit-lib from Rust — the same engine that powers the grit CLI.
- [grit-lib API map](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/api-map/index.md): Generated index of public grit-lib modules and key types with docs.rs links.
- [Reachability bitmaps](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/bitmaps/index.md): Query pack and MIDX commit bitmaps for fast object reachability and counting.
- [Diff](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/diff/index.md): Tree-to-tree and index-to-worktree diffs, blob patches, and the DiffEntry model the grit CLI renders.
- [Embedding grit-lib](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/embedding/index.md): Run multiple repositories in one process with explicit Environment, sinks, subprocess injection, and typed errors.
- [Network](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/network/index.md): Remote dispatch, fetch, push, and ls-remote over every transport.
- [Object stores](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/object-stores/index.md): Pluggable ObjectStore backends, OdbBuilder, and the odb_conformance test suite.
- [Objects](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/objects/index.md): ObjectId, ObjectKind, and reading or writing blobs, trees, and commits through Odb.
- [Pack reachability bitmaps](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/pack-bitmaps/index.md): Read and write Git pack `.bitmap` sidecars (EWAH reachability sets, name-hash cache, lookup tables).
- [Refs](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/refs/index.md): Resolve HEAD, list branches and tags, update refs with reflog, and how grit-lib picks loose, packed, or reftable storage.
- [Repository](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/repository/index.md): Open and discover Git repositories with an explicit Environment, read git-dir vs work tree, load config, and handle grit_lib::Error.
- [Revwalk](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/revwalk/index.md): Resolve revisions, walk history with rev-list, ranges (A..B), ordering, and merge bases.
- [Index](https://grit-scm.com/docs/library/staging/index.md): Load the staging index, stage paths with porcelain add, and write a tree object from staged entries.

## Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](https://grit-scm.com/docs/benchmarks/index.md): Grit vs Git on realistic workloads, from the committed grit-bench baseline.

## Optional

- [grit-lib on docs.rs](https://docs.rs/grit-lib): Rust API reference generated from crate rustdoc.
- [Grit is now maintained by a factory of agents](https://grit-scm.com/blog/the-grit-maintenance-factory/index.md): Grit now has an almost fully autonomous maintainer. Cloud agents plan the roadmap, fix issues, review each other's work, land changes, cut a release every day and test it on Linux, macOS and Windows. Here's how it works and where to watch it.
- [Goodbye grit-git](https://grit-scm.com/blog/goodbye-grit-git/index.md): We removed the Git-compatible grit-git CLI and the ported test harness. Grit is now two things: a complete Git library and a simpler CLI built on it.
- [A new site, and a new focus](https://grit-scm.com/blog/a-new-site-and-a-new-focus/index.md): Grit got far enough on Git's own test suite that the next problem isn't compatibility. It's speed and a library worth linking. Here's what changes.
- [grit is now the simple CLI](https://grit-scm.com/blog/grit-is-now-the-simple-cli/index.md): The grit binary you install is now the simple, library-first CLI. The fully git-compatible mirror moves to grit-git.
- [Introducing Grit](https://grit-scm.com/blog/introducing-grit/index.md): A short note on rebuilding Git in Rust, as a library, with compatibility as the benchmark.
- [Blog](https://grit-scm.com/blog/): release notes and project updates.
